name: Features
description: Grid of feature/service cards, each with title and text plus an optional icon, big number, or image depending on the variant. Cards can carry an individual link.
when_to_use: Service overviews, USP lists, process steps (numbered variant). Use River for alternating text+media storytelling and Stats for pure number KPIs.
capabilities: four card styles: icon cards, flat minimal with top border, big numbers, image cards
auto-numbering when num is empty (numbered/media variants)

variants.description: 3-column cards with icon and link. Default.
Minimal 3-column items with a top border, icon optional.
Big ordinal numbers (01, 02, …) instead of icons.
Cards with an image (items[].image) and number.

ai.prompt_summary: Features: feature/service card grid. Settings: variant (cards|flat|numbered|media), eyebrow, headline, intro. Cards in items[] (min 1): { num (e.g. '01', auto-numbered if empty), title, text, icon (Iconify name, cards/flat), image (media variant), link_label, link_to }.
ai.content_guidelines: 3 or 6 items for a clean grid. Titles 2-4 words, texts 1-2 sentences. Use consistent icon style (e.g. all i-lucide-*).

field_hints.items.icon: Iconify name like i-lucide-star; used by cards and flat variants.
field_hints.items.image: Only rendered by the media variant.
